subject.title: Add structured process events for sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a core, replayable session process-event API now, and what taxonomy, replay, authorization, and redaction contract should it use?
rationale: The request is useful but crosses stable gateway protocol, session state, plugin SDK, UI, and security boundaries, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent event contract.

options.title: Design the core contract first
options.body: Approve a short design for process/step taxonomy, persistence/replay, observer authorization, redaction, and migration from existing streams before any implementation PR.

options.title: Narrow to current streams
options.body: Document or improve existing agent/item/session.tool surfaces only, leaving this broader process-event contract out of scope for now.

options.title: Delegate to a plugin-specific surface
options.body: Keep core unchanged and ask ClawWork or another client/plugin to consume current generic streams, accepting that stable cross-client semantics remain unsolved.

recommendation.title: Design the core contract first
recommendation.body: Approve a short design for process/step taxonomy, persistence/replay, observer authorization, redaction, and migration from existing streams before any implementation PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and prior review history place this person closest to the central agent event and gateway session projection code.
